brief: A cabinet of three cells with two drawers, one of them shown pulled open.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:-1,0,0;half-n, piece:1,-1,0;half-n, all touching. The right half sits at (1,-1) because at (1,0) the configurator warned it wasn't attached.
drawer:0#-1,0#cut and drawer:0#1,-1#cut, one in the cut face of each half base
setDrawerOpen true on the drawer at (1,-1); the drawer at (-1,0) stays closed

finish.summary: Three-cell cabinet: a full base between two north-half bases, with a drawer in each half base's cut face; the drawer at (1,-1) is set open, the one at (-1,0) closed. 10 of 12 open edges have end caps; the 2 edges of the middle base facing the drawers can't take one because the cap would hit the drawer frames. The configurator's checks pass and its collision check is clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
